description: This file serves as a base class for implementation of integration tests related to device registry in the Eclipse Hono project. It provides utility methods for asserting error codes and disconnecting client factories, and defines abstract methods to be implemented by subclasses for testing specific functionalities.

classes.name: DeviceRegistryTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for integration tests targeting device registry components, providing common utility methods for error assertions and resource cleanup.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Abstract method to get the test helper instance used in subclasses.

methods.name: assertErrorCode
methods.description: Asserts that the provided Throwable is an instance of ServiceInvocationException with a specific error code.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Gracefully disconnects a given ConnectionLifecycle factory and signals completion to the test context, invalidating the connection.
